Module ingsw.myshelfie
Package it.polimi.myshelfie.network

Class NetworkMessage

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.myshelfie.network.NetworkMessage
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class NetworkMessage extends Object implements Serializable
Represents the generic network message. It has a specific messageType, a serialVersionUID, an event and 2 SerializableConsumer: clientFunction, used on the view, and serverFunction, used on the controllerGroup of the client.
